lines.speaker: header
lines.text: CALUMET COUNTY SHERIFF'S DEPARTMENT Page 841 Complaint No. File Number 05-0157-955

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Did you help take her clothes off?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: How did she get all her clothes off?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: That's got to be hard though, don't you think, trying to hide somebody and take their clothes off, by yourself? I think you helped, didn't you?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: So when you took her out to the garage, show me again how she was tied up, with her, with your hands.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: If she's alive and everything when you carried her out to the garage, is that true?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: Was she trying to hit 'em or anything?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: Yeah, who held the door open for him to get out in the garage or out of the house?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: Brendan, oh go ahead. Brendan, when you got home that night, did you wash any of your clothes? The truth, you don't have to think about that answer.
